job.script:
$module = (Get-Module ConsoleMonster).Path
Start-Job -ArgumentList $module {
    param($Module)
    Import-Module $Module
    [pscustomobject] @{ Check = 'SPF'; Status = 'Pass' }, [pscustomobject] @{ Check = 'DMARC'; Status = 'Fail' } |
        Write-ConsoleTable -Title 'From a background job' -StatusProperty Status
} | Receive-Job -Wait -AutoRemoveJob
job.scriptFull:

    [pscustomobject] @{ Check = 'SPF'; Status = 'Pass' }, [pscustomobject] @{ Check = 'DMARC'; Status = 'Fail' } |
        Write-ConsoleTable -Title 'From a background job' -StatusProperty Status
} | Receive-Job -Wait -AutoRemoveJob

export-markdown.script:
# The largest files in PowerShell's folder, as a Markdown table for a report.
Get-ChildItem -Path $PSHOME -File |
    Sort-Object -Property Length -Descending |
    Select-Object -First 5 |
    Format-ConsoleTable -Property Name, Length, LastWriteTime -As Markdown

streams.script:
# Show every stream for this demo.
$VerbosePreference = 'Continue'
$DebugPreference = 'Continue'

Write-ConsoleRule "PowerShell's own colours"
Write-Warning 'Certificate for mail.evotec.xyz expires in 12 days'
Write-Verbose 'Queried 4 domain controllers in 2 domains'
Write-Debug 'Cache hit for evotec.xyz'

Enable-ConsoleFormatting -Feature Streams

Write-ConsoleRule 'With -Feature Streams: the theme''s colours'
Write-Warning 'Certificate for mail.evotec.xyz expires in 12 days'
Write-Verbose 'Queried 4 domain controllers in 2 domains'
Write-Debug 'Cache hit for evotec.xyz'

Disable-ConsoleFormatting -Feature Streams

commands.name: Write-ConsoleException
commands.synopsis: Writes an error or exception readably (Format-ConsoleError without -AsWidget).

commands.name: Write-ConsoleKeyValue
commands.synopsis: Writes an aligned key/value list.

commands.name: Write-ConsoleLog
commands.synopsis: Writes a line to the log region of a running dashboard.

commands.name: Write-ConsoleMarkup
commands.synopsis: Writes Spectre-compatible markup as styled text.

commands.name: Write-ConsoleProgress
commands.synopsis: Writes a progress update, drawn by ConsoleMonster when Enable-ConsoleFormatting -Feature Progress is on.

commands.name: Write-ConsoleRule
commands.synopsis: Writes a horizontal rule, optionally with a title.

commands.name: Write-ConsoleStatus
commands.synopsis: Shows one status line that updates in place, with an optional spinner, clock and elapsed time.

commands.name: Write-ConsoleTable
commands.synopsis: Writes pipeline objects as a console table.

commands.name: Write-ConsoleText
commands.synopsis: Writes multicolour text to the console and, optionally, to a log file: Write-Color compatible, with markup, styles, gradients, padding, wrapping and structured logs.

commands.name: Write-ConsoleTree
commands.synopsis: Writes a console tree from New-ConsoleTreeNode calls, hierarchical objects or nested hashtables.

commands.name: Write-ConsoleWidget
commands.synopsis: Writes console widgets once (tables, trees, panels, charts, dashboards).

commands.name: Format-ConsoleCode
commands.synopsis: Shows source text with syntax highlighting, line numbers and highlighted lines.

commands.name: Format-ConsoleError
commands.synopsis: Shows errors and exceptions readably: type, message, position, script stack, frames and inner errors.

commands.name: Format-ConsoleJson
commands.synopsis: Shows JSON with syntax highlighting: JSON text re-indented, or objects written as JSON.

commands.name: Format-ConsoleList
commands.synopsis: Formats pipeline objects as record views (labelled values) and writes them to the host.

commands.name: Format-ConsoleTable
commands.synopsis: Formats pipeline objects as a width-aware table and writes it to the host.

commands.name: Format-ConsoleTree
commands.synopsis: Shows the structure of pipeline objects as a tree (or an inspector view) and writes it to the host.

commands.name: New-ConsoleActivityList
commands.synopsis: Creates an activity list: the work in progress right now, one row per activity, with a spinner or a bar and the time it has taken.

commands.name: New-ConsoleAlign
commands.synopsis: Aligns console widgets left, centre or right, and top, middle or bottom, inside their space.

commands.name: New-ConsoleBarChart
commands.synopsis: Creates a horizontal bar chart, or a stacked bar with -Stacked.

commands.name: New-ConsoleBarItem
commands.synopsis: Creates one bar of a bar chart, or one segment of a stacked bar, with its own tone.

commands.name: New-ConsoleBinding
commands.synopsis: Creates a display rebuilt from application state on the owning PowerShell input thread.

commands.name: New-ConsoleButton
commands.synopsis: Creates a named action button for Show-ConsoleApp.

commands.name: New-ConsoleCellMap
commands.synopsis: Creates a cell map: one status symbol per item of a run, with a legend of counts.

commands.name: New-ConsoleChartSeries
commands.synopsis: Creates one series of a line or scatter chart: a name, values and an optional tone.

commands.name: New-ConsoleClock
commands.synopsis: Creates a run clock (ConsoleMonster.Live.SimulatedClock) the script moves forward, for simulated runs whose screen shows simulated time.

commands.name: New-ConsoleColumns
commands.synopsis: Places console widgets side by side.

commands.name: New-ConsoleDashboard
commands.synopsis: Defines a live console dashboard: a header with title and clock, the body and a footer.

commands.name: New-ConsoleField
commands.synopsis: Creates a form field for New-ConsoleForm.

commands.name: New-ConsoleForm
commands.synopsis: Creates a form or wizard from fields (New-ConsoleField) for Read-ConsoleForm or a menu item.

commands.name: New-ConsoleFormPreset
commands.synopsis: Creates a preset a form comes with: field values under one name, with a description and a preview.

commands.name: New-ConsoleGrid
commands.synopsis: Lays console widgets out in an equal-width grid.

commands.name: New-ConsoleHistogram
commands.synopsis: Creates a histogram of values counted into buckets.

commands.name: New-ConsoleKeyValue
commands.synopsis: Creates an aligned key/value list from a hashtable, an object's properties or New-ConsoleKeyValueItem pairs.

commands.name: New-ConsoleKeyValueItem
commands.synopsis: Creates one key/value pair, with an optional status or presenter, for New-ConsoleKeyValue.

commands.name: New-ConsoleLane
commands.synopsis: Creates one lane (a worker, server or item of a parallel workload) for New-ConsoleLanes.

commands.name: New-ConsoleLanes
commands.synopsis: Creates a lanes widget: one row per worker, server or item of a parallel workload.

commands.name: New-ConsoleLineChart
commands.synopsis: Creates a line or scatter chart (braille on modern fonts, half blocks on Consolas, characters in ASCII mode).

commands.name: New-ConsoleLiveTable
commands.synopsis: Creates a table whose rows change while a dashboard runs.

commands.name: New-ConsoleLog
commands.synopsis: Creates a log region: the newest lines of a log, bottom-aligned.

commands.name: New-ConsoleLogEntry
commands.synopsis: Creates one log line with a level and a time, for New-ConsoleLog.

commands.name: New-ConsoleLogo
commands.synopsis: Creates banner text drawn with a pixel font and a colour gradient.

commands.name: New-ConsoleMenu
commands.synopsis: Creates a menu from items (New-ConsoleMenuItem) for Show-ConsoleMenu.

commands.name: New-ConsoleMenuItem
commands.synopsis: Creates a menu item: an action, a submenu, a form, a selection, a page, a review, the presets list, a separator or the exit.

commands.name: New-ConsoleMenuPreset
commands.synopsis: Creates a preset a menu comes with: form values and selections under one name, with a description and a preview.

commands.name: New-ConsoleMultiSelect
commands.synopsis: Creates a named multiselect input for Show-ConsoleApp.

commands.name: New-ConsolePadding
commands.synopsis: Adds empty space around console widgets.

commands.name: New-ConsolePanel
commands.synopsis: Creates a bordered panel with a title around other console widgets.

commands.name: New-ConsolePhases
commands.synopsis: Creates a phase strip for pipelines: Restore › Build › Test › Pack.

commands.name: New-ConsoleProgress
commands.synopsis: Creates a labelled progress bar.

commands.name: New-ConsoleRegion
commands.synopsis: Creates a named region whose content can be replaced while a dashboard runs.

commands.name: New-ConsoleRows
commands.synopsis: Stacks console widgets vertically.

commands.name: New-ConsoleRule
commands.synopsis: Creates a horizontal rule, optionally with a title.

commands.name: New-ConsoleRunResult
commands.synopsis: Creates the result a menu run returns: a title, a status, a summary, figures and next actions.

commands.name: New-ConsoleSelect
commands.synopsis: Creates a named select input for Show-ConsoleApp.

commands.name: New-ConsoleSparkline
commands.synopsis: Creates a sparkline: a compact trend of recent values.

commands.name: New-ConsoleSpinner
commands.synopsis: Creates a spinner: a one-line activity indicator for work without a known total.

commands.name: New-ConsoleStack
commands.synopsis: Layers console widgets on top of each other in the same space.

commands.name: New-ConsoleStatusItem
commands.synopsis: Creates one status item, a step with a status and a detail, for New-ConsoleStatusList and New-ConsolePhases.

commands.name: New-ConsoleStatusList
commands.synopsis: Creates a checklist of items with status markers.

commands.name: New-ConsoleSummaryBar
commands.synopsis: Creates a summary bar: one line with progress, done of total, the time left and result counters.

commands.name: New-ConsoleTable
commands.synopsis: Creates a console table from pipeline objects.

commands.name: New-ConsoleText
commands.synopsis: Creates rich text: multicolour words for table cells, calculated properties, titles, labels, log lines or output on its own.

commands.name: New-ConsoleTextArea
commands.synopsis: Creates a named multiline text input for Show-ConsoleApp.

commands.name: New-ConsoleTextInput
commands.synopsis: Creates a named single-line text input for Show-ConsoleApp.

commands.name: New-ConsoleToggle
commands.synopsis: Creates a named Boolean toggle for Show-ConsoleApp.

commands.name: New-ConsoleTree
commands.synopsis: Creates a console tree from nested New-ConsoleTreeNode calls, hierarchical objects or nested hashtables.

commands.name: New-ConsoleTreeNode
commands.synopsis: Creates a tree node with an optional status, a muted detail and child nodes, for New-ConsoleTree.

commands.name: Start-ConsoleDashboard
commands.synopsis: Runs a console dashboard live while a script does the work.

commands.name: Start-ConsoleReplay
commands.synopsis: Replays a recorded dashboard session (JSON lines) into a dashboard.

commands.name: Update-ConsoleActivity
commands.synopsis: Starts, updates or finishes an activity of an activity list (New-ConsoleActivityList) in the running dashboard.

commands.name: Update-ConsoleCell
commands.synopsis: Sets the state of cells of a cell map (New-ConsoleCellMap) in the running dashboard.

commands.name: Update-ConsoleLane
commands.synopsis: Updates a lane of a running dashboard: progress, step results, status and detail.

commands.name: Update-ConsolePhase
commands.synopsis: Updates a phase of a running dashboard's phase strip.

commands.name: Update-ConsoleProgress
commands.synopsis: Updates a progress bar in a running dashboard.

commands.name: Update-ConsoleSpinner
commands.synopsis: Updates a spinner in a running dashboard.

commands.name: Update-ConsoleStatus
commands.synopsis: Updates an item of a status list in a running dashboard.

commands.name: Update-ConsoleSummaryBar
commands.synopsis: Updates a summary bar (New-ConsoleSummaryBar) in the running dashboard: progress and counters.

commands.name: Update-ConsoleTable
commands.synopsis: Adds, updates, removes or clears rows of a live table (New-ConsoleLiveTable) in the running dashboard.

commands.name: Read-ConsoleConfirm
commands.synopsis: Asks a yes/no question and returns $true or $false.

commands.name: Read-ConsoleForm
commands.synopsis: Shows a form or wizard and returns the answers.

commands.name: Read-ConsoleMultiSelection
commands.synopsis: Asks the user to pick any number of the choices and returns the chosen objects.

commands.name: Read-ConsoleNumber
commands.synopsis: Asks for a number.

commands.name: Read-ConsolePath
commands.synopsis: Asks for a file or folder path, with completion.

commands.name: Read-ConsoleSecret
commands.synopsis: Asks for a secret and returns a SecureString (or a string with -AsPlainText).

commands.name: Read-ConsoleSelection
commands.synopsis: Asks the user to pick one of the choices and returns the chosen object.

commands.name: Read-ConsoleText
commands.synopsis: Asks for a line of text.

commands.name: Show-Console
commands.synopsis: Shows pipeline input in the view that fits it best.

commands.name: Show-ConsoleApp
commands.synopsis: Runs native input controls and dependent displays in a console application.

commands.name: Show-ConsoleChanges
commands.synopsis: Shows the changes an action would make and asks before making them: the what-if pattern.

commands.name: Show-ConsoleGrid
commands.synopsis: Shows pipeline objects in an interactive grid and returns the rows you choose.

commands.name: Show-ConsoleHelp
commands.synopsis: Shows a command's help: synopsis, highlighted syntax, a parameter table and highlighted examples.

commands.name: Show-ConsoleMenu
commands.synopsis: Shows a menu until the user exits.

commands.name: Show-ConsoleReplay
commands.synopsis: Rewinds a recorded run: an in-terminal player with a timeline, markers, failures, warnings and log search.

commands.name: Export-ConsoleFrame
commands.synopsis: Exports a widget, a rendered frame or a live-session snapshot to HTML, SVG, Markdown or text.

commands.name: Export-ConsoleRecording
commands.synopsis: Exports a dashboard recording to an HTML player, an animated SVG or asciicast.

commands.name: Invoke-ConsolePester
commands.synopsis: Runs Pester tests with a live ConsoleMonster dashboard and a summary table.

commands.name: Invoke-ConsoleRun
commands.synopsis: Runs a script block for every input item, optionally in parallel, with a live view of the run.

commands.name: Add-ConsoleItem
commands.synopsis: Adds items to a console widget made earlier: tree nodes, pairs, status items, bars, series, log lines, lanes or values.

commands.name: Add-ConsoleValue
commands.synopsis: Adds a value to a chart in a running dashboard.

commands.name: Assert-ConsoleOutput
commands.synopsis: Compares console output with a golden file (for Pester and other tests).

commands.name: Clear-ConsoleScreen
commands.synopsis: Clears the console screen, safely.

commands.name: Compare-ConsoleObject
commands.synopsis: Compares two sets of objects and shows what was added, removed and changed, property by property.

commands.name: Compare-ConsoleText
commands.synopsis: Compares text or files with numbered lines, highlighted words and collapsed unchanged regions.

commands.name: Copy-ConsoleOutput
commands.synopsis: Copies widgets, frames, text or pipeline objects to the operating-system clipboard.

commands.name: Disable-ConsoleFormatting
commands.synopsis: Turns off the ConsoleMonster default formatting (Enable-ConsoleFormatting), all of it or some features.

commands.name: Enable-ConsoleFormatting
commands.synopsis: Shows the default output of common types through ConsoleMonster for this session (opt-in).

commands.name: Get-ConsoleCapability
commands.synopsis: Shows what ConsoleMonster detected about the current terminal.

commands.name: Out-ConsoleDefault
commands.synopsis: Shows objects of registered types through ConsoleMonster and passes everything else to PowerShell's Out-Default.

commands.name: Out-ConsoleFormatCommand
commands.synopsis: Renders native PowerShell formatting records through ConsoleMonster.

commands.name: Register-ConsoleView
commands.synopsis: Registers how a type is shown by Enable-ConsoleFormatting and Out-ConsoleDefault.

commands.name: Send-ConsoleEvent
commands.synopsis: Sends a raw live event to any widget of a running dashboard.

commands.name: Set-ConsoleFormValue
commands.synopsis: Sets field values of a form, whether or not it is shown.

commands.name: Set-ConsoleRegion
commands.synopsis: Replaces the content of a region (New-ConsoleRegion) in the running dashboard.

commands.name: Set-ConsoleTheme
commands.synopsis: Selects the theme used by every ConsoleMonster widget.

commands.name: Set-ConsoleValue
commands.synopsis: Sets a value in a running dashboard: a key/value pair, a bar or a stacked-bar segment.

commands.name: Use-ConsoleProgress
commands.synopsis: Runs a script and shows its Write-Progress calls as an inline progress area.

commands.name: Use-ConsoleTarget
commands.synopsis: Runs a script block with ConsoleMonster output going somewhere else: a file, a text writer, any target, or a string.

commands.name: Watch-Console
commands.synopsis: Runs a script block again and again and shows its latest output as a live view.
